{{Quote|The tracking station in Pastil is fully operational.|[[Cody/Legends|Cody]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Pastil system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated along the [[Manda Merchant Route/Legends|Manda Merchant Route]] near the [[Rishi system/Legends|Rishi system]].<ref name="TEA" />

It contained the astronomical object [[Pastil/Legends|Pastil]],<ref name="TOSVC32" /> which was the site of a [[Pastil tracking station/Legends|tracking station]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and operated by [[Shiny/Legends|rookie]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] during the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="MH">''[[The Clone Wars: Mouse Hunt]]''</ref>
